docs.title: Verifying the signature
docs.body: Every request carries these headers. Compute the HMAC SHA-256 of the timestamp, a dot and the raw body, keyed with the secret, and compare it with the signature. Drop requests whose timestamp is too old.
docs.delivery: Delivery id, the same on every attempt
docs.signature: sha256= followed by the hex HMAC
docs.timestamp: When it was sent, the same value used in the signature
docs.retries: A 2xx answer within 10 seconds confirms the delivery. Otherwise we retry up to 5 times, waiting longer each time. Redirects are not followed.

privacyDocs.title: Documents
privacyDocs.intro: The record of processing filled in with your organization's data, and the templates to have reviewed by a lawyer.

register.title: Record of processing activities
register.subtitle: Art. 30 GDPR. Processing: recruitment.
register.contactMissing: Not set: it comes from the privacy notice
register.purposesText: Receiving and assessing applications, communicating with applicants and, only with consent, keeping a talent pool for future positions.
register.legalBasisText: Selection: pre-contractual steps at the person's request (art. 6.1.b). Talent pool: separate, revocable consent (art. 6.1.a).
register.subjectsText: Candidates; internal users for access and the activity log.
register.dataText: Identity and contact data, CV and experience, notes and messages of the selection, proof of consent. No special categories of data.
register.retentionText: {selection} for this selection only, {pool} for the talent pool, from the day of consent. Automatic erasure, files included.
register.retentionMissing: To be set: publish the privacy notice to set the periods.
register.measuresText: Data separated by organization, permissions by role and by job, append-only activity log, automatic erasure at expiry.
register.automatedText: None: the system does not rank or reject candidates.

migrations.description: Bring your recruiting history over from another ATS: jobs, candidates, outcomes, notes and emails. You check a preview before anything is written, and you can undo the whole migration.

upload.title: Upload the package

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
rateLimited.body: Wait a few minutes, then reload the page.

unavailable.title: Page not available
unavailable.body: We cannot load the form right now. Please try again later.

reconfirm.title: Your data at {organization}
reconfirm.intro: {organization} imported your CV into its recruiting system, for the {job} position.
reconfirm.introNoJob: {organization} imported your CV into its recruiting system.
reconfirm.choice: You did not apply here, so the choice is yours: you can confirm they may keep your data, or ask for it to be erased.
reconfirm.deadline: If you do not answer by {date}, your data is erased anyway.
reconfirm.decline: I do not want my data to be kept
reconfirm.declineHint: If you do not confirm, we erase all your data at once: CV, contacts and notes. It cannot be undone.

done.title: Thank you, you confirmed
done.body: {organization} may keep your data for this selection. You can withdraw consent whenever you like by writing to {email}.

erased.title: Your data has been erased
erased.body: {organization} no longer has your CV or your contacts. You will not receive further messages about this selection.

invalid.title: Invalid link
invalid.body: This link does not work. Check that you copied all of it from the email.

expired.title: Link expired
expired.body: The time to answer is over and your data has already been erased.

used.title: You already answered
used.body: This request already has an answer. To change your choice, write to the company directly.

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts
rateLimited.body: Wait a few minutes, then reload the page.

unavailable.title: Page unavailable
unavailable.body: We cannot load the request right now. Please try again later.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: How hiring is going in the chosen period: timing, moves between stages, where applications come from and responses.

errors.order: The start date comes after the end date.
errors.future: The end date cannot be in the future.

reports.smallSample: With fewer than {min} cases a percentage says little: you will see a dash instead.
reports.sectionError: This section could not be shown.

empty.title: No activity in this period
empty.body: Figures appear as soon as applications, responses and outcomes come in. Try a longer period or another job.

timeToHire.label: Median time to hire
timeToHire.basis: no hires | over 1 hire | over {count} hires
timeToHire.info: Days from application to hire: half of the people hired took less.

responses.label: Responses on time
responses.info: Responses sent within the days promised in the ad, out of all responses due in the period.

coverage.label: Applications with an outcome
coverage.info: Applications that got an outcome, among those for jobs closed or online for at least 60 days.

received.label: Applications received
received.info: Applications that came in during the period, from any source.

funnel.title: Moves between stages
funnel.info: How many applications entered each stage in the period and how many moved on to the next one.
funnel.emptyBody: Here you will see how many applications enter each stage and how many move on.

sources.title: Sources
sources.info: Where applications come from and how many hires each source leads to.
sources.emptyBody: Share the tracked link of each ad (Distribution tab of the ad, or add ?utm_source=linkedin by hand) to know where people come from.
sources.noVisits: No visits counted in this period. A visit is counted when someone opens the ad from the careers page or from a tracked link: build one in the Distribution tab of the ad.

responses.title: Response times
responses.info: By stage type: responses sent within the promised days and responses sent late.
responses.emptyTitle: No responses due in this period
responses.emptyBody: Every ad promises a response within a number of days: here you will see how often the promise was kept.

times.title: Timing per job
times.info: Hire: days from application to hire. Fill: days from publication to the first hire.
times.fillMedian: day median time to fill | days median time to fill
times.emptyBody: When an application ends with a hire, the days it took show up here.

security.pageDescription: Protect your account with a second factor, and decide what your organization requires.

personal.title: Two-factor authentication
personal.description: After the password, the sign-in asks for a code from an authenticator app (any TOTP app works).
personal.required: Your organization requires it for your role: turn it on to keep using the app.
personal.passwordHint: Needed to change how you sign in.
personal.scan: Scan the code with your authenticator app, or enter the key below by hand, or open the link on your phone.
personal.qrAlt: QR code with the key for your authenticator app
personal.backupBody: Save them somewhere safe: each one signs you in once if you lose the phone. They are shown only now.

organization.title: Organization requirement
organization.description: Owners and administrators must have two-factor authentication on to use the app. Each of them is asked to turn it on at the next visit.
organization.toggle: Require two-factor authentication for owners and administrators

jobTeam.title: Team
jobTeam.explain: Who sees the candidates of this ad. Owners and admins see every ad, and so do recruiters unless the organization restricts them to their teams. Hiring managers and interviewers see only the ads whose team they are on. Whoever runs a stage is on the team automatically.
jobTeam.saveFailed: We could not change the team.

notAccessible.title: Not found or not accessible
notAccessible.body: This page no longer exists, or it belongs to an ad whose team you are not on. Ask whoever manages the ad to add you to its team.

video.privacy: The video loads from {provider} only when you press play: until then no request goes to {provider}.

careersSite.footer: Salary and selection process are always stated here, before you apply.

stale.message: Someone else saved or published the page after you opened it. To avoid overwriting their work, your changes were not saved: reload to see the current version.

state.invalid: 1 issue to fix | {count} issues to fix

save.invalid: Fix the issues shown: the draft is saved once the page is valid.

publish.blocked: Fix the issues shown to publish.

languages.defaultHint: What visitors read when a text is not written in their language.

sections.title: Sections
sections.deleteBody: The section and its texts leave the draft. Images stay in the library.

hero.name: Hero
hero.description: The large headline at the top, with an optional image or video behind.

text.name: Text
text.description: A block of text with an optional title.

gallery.name: Gallery
gallery.description: From 2 to 9 photos, each with its description.

video.name: Video
video.description: An uploaded video, or one from YouTube or Vimeo.

values.name: Values and perks
values.description: From 3 to 8 points with an icon, a title and a line of text.

numbers.name: Numbers
numbers.description: From 2 to 4 figures about the company.

testimonials.name: Testimonials
testimonials.description: In the words of the people who work with you.

jobs.name: Open positions
jobs.description: The list of published ads, always up to date.

common.title: Title
common.paragraphs: A blank line starts a new paragraph.
common.altHint: Screen reader users hear it: describe what the image shows.

hero.headline: Headline
hero.videoHint: It plays muted and visitors can pause it.
hero.posterHint: Shown while the video loads, and instead of it for visitors who reduce motion.
hero.overlayHint: At least {min}% with an image or video, so the headline stays readable.

video.titleHint: It is also the player’s name for screen reader users.
video.caption: Caption
video.privacy: Nothing loads from YouTube or Vimeo until the visitor presses play: before that, no request reaches the provider.
video.posterHint: Required: shown before the video starts.
video.posterLinkHint: Optional: without it, a plain frame with the play button is shown.

numbers.valueHint: Short, as you would write it: 42, 3.5k, 98%.
numbers.label: Label

jobs.note: The list is automatic: it shows the published ads with pay and selection process. Response times are not shown in this list.

theme.title: Look
theme.passes: Contrast {ratio}:1, the button label reads well.
theme.fails: Contrast {ratio}:1, the button label does not read. Pick a darker or lighter colour.

media.description: Upload a new file or pick one from the organization’s library.

empty.image: No images in the library yet: upload one above.
empty.video: No videos in the library yet: upload one above.

file.image: Image file (JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF)

limits.image: Up to {max} MB. Hidden photo data, such as location, is removed.

media.altHint: At least one language is needed: screen reader users hear it.

errors.unsupported_type: Unsupported format: use JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF for images, MP4 or WebM for videos.
errors.too_large: File too large: up to 8 MB for an image and 60 MB for a video.
errors.alt_required: Write the image description in at least one language.
errors.image_unreadable: This image cannot be read: try saving it again as JPEG or PNG.
errors.image_too_big: Image too large: reduce it below 50 megapixels.
errors.library_full: The library is full: delete the files you no longer use.
errors.in_published_page: The file is on the published page: remove it and publish again before deleting it.
errors.in_draft: The file is in the draft: remove it and save before deleting it.

errors.testimonials_min: At least one testimonial is needed.
errors.links_min: At least one link is needed.
errors.jobs_exactly_one: The page must contain the open positions, exactly once.
errors.hero_first: The hero must be the first section.
errors.hero_at_most_one: The page can have only one hero.
errors.overlay_too_low: With an image or video the veil must be at least 40%.
errors.accent_contrast: No text reads on this colour: pick a darker or lighter one.
errors.media_missing: The file is no longer in the library: choose another one.
errors.video_id: Paste the link of a YouTube or Vimeo video.
errors.video_url: This link is not a YouTube or Vimeo video.
errors.url: Write a full web address, starting with https://
errors.duplicate_id: Two sections have the same id.

text.title: About us
text.body: Tell in a few lines who you are, what you do and why people should work with you.

imageText.title: Where we work
imageText.body: Describe where the work happens: the office, remote work, the team.

trackedLinks.title: Tracked links
trackedLinks.description: One link per channel shows where visits and applications come from, in Reports. Nothing about the visitor is stored: only counts per day, source and campaign.
trackedLinks.customHint: Letters, numbers, dots and dashes, for example career-day-milan.
trackedLinks.campaignHint: For example autumn-2026. Use the same name on every channel of the campaign.
trackedLinks.invalidChannel: This is not a usable channel name.
trackedLinks.invalidCampaign: This is not a usable campaign name, it will be left out.
trackedLinks.pick: Choose a channel to get the link.
trackedLinks.notPublished: Publish the ad to get links you can share.
trackedLinks.privacy: Counts only: no cookies, no IP addresses, nobody is followed from page to page.

visits.title: Where visits and applications come from
visits.description: The last 90 days, for this ad only.
visits.error: The figures could not be loaded.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.intro: What happened to this application, oldest first. The last line is where it stands now.
